description: Native IFT train contact check plus summary figure: interface residue conservation and domain-specific divergence in nematodes
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# 8BD7 native-train check: which IFT46 / IFT52 regions are apposed
txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8BD7.cif",timeout=180).text
rows=[]
for l in txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        f=l.split()
        if f[3]=='CA':
            rows.append((f[20] if len(f)>20 else f[-1], f[5], f[8], f[10], f[11], f[12]))
# robust: parse via fixed columns of mmCIF atom_site loop header
hdr=[]; data=[]
inloop=False
for l in txt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('_atom_site.'): hdr.append(l.strip().split('.')[1]); inloop=True; continue
    if inloop:
        if l.startswith('#') or l.startswith('loop_'): break
        data.append(l.split())
df=pd.DataFrame(data,columns=hdr)
df=df[(df.group_PDB=='ATOM')&(df.label_atom_id=='CA')]
df['x']=df.Cartn_x.astype(float); df['y']=df.Cartn_y.astype(float); df['z']=df.Cartn_z.astype(float)
df['res']=df.auth_seq_id.astype(int)
D=df[df.auth_asym_id=='D']; B=df[df.auth_asym_id=='B']
print("8BD7 chain D (CrIFT46) modelled residues:",D.res.min(),"-",D.res.max(),"n=",len(D))
print("8BD7 chain B (CrIFT52/Osm-6-like) modelled residues:",B.res.min(),"-",B.res.max(),"n=",len(B))
P=D[['x','y','z']].values; Q=B[['x','y','z']].values
M=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2)
i,j=np.where(M<=12)
print(f"CA-CA pairs <=12 A between IFT46 and IFT52 in the fitted train model: {len(i)}")
if len(i):
    r46=sorted(set(D.res.values[i])); r52=sorted(set(B.res.values[j]))
    print(" IFT46 residues at the IFT52 contact:", f"{min(r46)}-{max(r46)}", "n=",len(r46))
    print("   -> fraction in IFT46_B_C domain (>=200):", round(np.mean([x>=200 for x in r46]),2))
    print(" IFT52 residues at the IFT46 contact:", f"{min(r52)}-{max(r52)}", "n=",len(r52))
    print("   -> fraction in IFT52 C-term (>=330):", round(np.mean([x>=330 for x in r52]),2))

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
iface=pd.DataFrame([("K236",18,"K365","identical"),("Q239",1,"P368","different"),("P240",10,"A369","different"),
("H241",10,"Q370","different"),("S242",9,"T371","similar"),("V243",12,"V372","identical"),("L255",6,"L384","identical"),
("M256",4,"M385","identical"),("Q257",10,"Q386","identical"),("E258",13,"E387","identical"),("W259",48,"W388","identical"),
("E264",28,"E393","identical"),("L267",1,"L396","identical"),("I272",6,"I401","identical"),("S274",9,"S403","identical"),
("E276",1,"E405","identical"),("F279",4,"V408","different"),("N280",3,"S409","similar"),("L281",23,"L410","identical"),
("S282",4,"E411","different"),("F284",24,"Y413","similar"),("C285",7,"V414","different"),("A288",6,"C417","different"),
("I291",4,"I420","identical"),("L292",6,"V421","similar"),("N301",2,"-","gap"),("E302",19,"G426","different"),
("S303",16,"K427","different"),("N304",8,"S428","similar"),("V305",13,"R429","different"),("I306",33,"I430","identical"),
("L309",14,"L433","identical"),("H310",20,"H434","identical"),("L312",7,"M436","similar"),("F313",29,"F437","identical"),
("T314",1,"S438","similar"),("L315",6,"L439","identical"),("Y316",30,"L440","different"),("S317",13,"N441","similar"),
("E318",11,"E442","identical"),("F319",20,"F443","identical"),("K320",3,"N444","different"),("S321",4,"N445","similar"),
("Q323",5,"Q447","identical"),("H324",2,"H448","identical")],columns=["Tt","contacts","CE","cls"])
dom=pd.DataFrame([("Danio rerio","motile",200,306),("Xenopus tropicalis","motile",184,291),("Homo sapiens","motile",164,293),
("Mus musculus","motile",164,287),("Trypanosoma brucei","motile",146,263),("Drosophila melanogaster","motile",112,87),
("Brugia malayi","nematode",88,275),("Strongyloides ratti","nematode",84,255),("Caenorhabditis elegans","nematode",80,250),
("Caenorhabditis briggsae","nematode",73,181),("Trichinella spiralis","nematode",25,232)],
 columns=["species","group","Nterm","Cterm"])
dom['ratio']=dom.Nterm/dom.Cterm

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(19,6.2))
col={"identical":"#1b7837","similar":"#7fbf7b","different":"#d6604d","gap":"#bbbbbb"}
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(range(len(iface)), iface.contacts, color=[col[c] for c in iface.cls])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(iface))); ax.set_xticklabels(iface.Tt, rotation=90, fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_ylabel("heavy-atom contacts to IFT52 (4UZZ, 4.5 A)")
ax.set_xlabel("TtIFT46 interface residue (UniProt numbering)")
ax.set_title("IFT52-contacting residues of IFT46 and their\nstatus in C. elegans DYF-6")
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=col[k]) for k in ["identical","similar","different","gap"]]
ax.legend(h,["identical in DYF-6","similar","different","not aligned"],fontsize=8,frameon=False)

ax=axes[1]
x=np.arange(2)
cw=62.0; aw=52.3; nonif=39.7
ax.bar([0,1,2],[cw,aw,nonif],color=["#2166ac","#67a9cf","#bbbbbb"])
ax.set_xticks([0,1,2]); ax.set_xticklabels(["interface,\ncontact-weighted","interface,\nunweighted","non-interface\n(same domain)"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% identity, DYF-6 vs TtIFT46"); ax.set_ylim(0,75)
for i,v in enumerate([cw,aw,nonif]): ax.text(i,v+1.5,f"{v:.1f}%",ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.set_title("Interface positions are the best-conserved part\nof the DYF-6 IFT46_B_C domain (Fisher p=0.24)")

ax=axes[2]
for g,mk,c in [("motile","o","#2166ac"),("nematode","s","#b2182b")]:
    d=dom[dom.group==g]
    ax.scatter(d.Cterm,d.Nterm,marker=mk,s=70,color=c,label=g+" cilia" if g=="motile" else "nematode (sensory only)")
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        ax.annotate(r.species.split()[0][:4]+". "+r.species.split()[1][:4],(r.Cterm,r.Nterm),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.plot([0,320],[0,320],ls=':',c='grey',lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("SW score vs TtIFT46_B_C domain (C-terminal)")
ax.set_ylabel("SW score vs CrIFT46 1-147 (ODA16-binding region)")
ax.set_title("Nematode IFT46 keeps the C-terminal IFT52 module\nbut not the N-terminal ODA16 module")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
